boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named Rohnert Park destinations on practical off-campus corridors, each paired with a documented activity or feature.

cards.title: Community Center programs on Snyder Lane
cards.subtitle: Snyder Lane corridor — Rohnert Park Community Center
cards.notes: Check the City recreation guide or front desk before you go; the Community Center is the city’s program and registration point at 5401 Snyder Lane.
cards.short_summary: A municipal starting point for Rohnert Park recreation programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists the Rohnert Park Community Center at 5401 Snyder Lane and identifies it as part of Community Services.
cards.access_notes: City page lists Monday–Friday office hours, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; confirm program availability separately.

cards.title: Fitness and gym time on Snyder Lane
cards.subtitle: Snyder Lane corridor — Callinan Sports and Fitness Center
cards.notes: Use the City’s current recreation information to check gym availability, classes, and membership requirements before heading to 5405 Snyder Lane.
cards.short_summary: A City fitness center beside the Community Center complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Callinan Sports and Fitness Center at 5405 Snyder Lane and lists its public operating hours.
cards.source_title: City of Rohnert Park Community Services
cards.access_notes: The City lists Monday–Friday 6 a.m.–9 p.m. and weekends 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; access may require membership or a fee.

cards.title: A performance calendar on Snyder Lane
cards.subtitle: Snyder Lane corridor — Spreckels Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Look at the venue’s event calendar and ticket details, then plan around the specific show; its box office is at 5409 Snyder Lane.
cards.short_summary: A Rohnert Park performing-arts venue with a dedicated box office.
cards.evidence_claim: Spreckels Performing Arts Center lists its location as 5409 Snyder Lane in Rohnert Park and provides box-office contact information.
cards.access_notes: Ticketing and event access vary by performance; contact the box office for current details.

cards.title: Reading room and public computers on Lynne Condé Way
cards.subtitle: Lynne Condé Way corridor — Rohnert Park Cotati Regional Library
cards.notes: Bring a library card if you have one, or ask staff about access; the branch has public computers, a community room, and a bookstore.
cards.short_summary: A regional library with study-oriented amenities and a detailed local-history setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Sonoma County Library says the Rohnert Park Cotati Regional Library at 6250 Lynne Condé Way has public computers, a community room, and a Friends bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Library page lists current branch hours; buildings close on holidays.

cards.title: Courts and fields on Golf Course Drive
cards.subtitle: Golf Course Drive corridor — Golis Park
cards.notes: Use the play equipment, courts, or open recreation areas during a daytime visit, and check City field conditions if you plan organized play.
cards.short_summary: A 13-acre City park combining play equipment, courts, and several field types.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes Golis Park at 1450 Golf Course Drive as a 13-acre park with play equipment, baseball and multi-use fields, basketball courts, and picnic tables.
cards.access_notes: For organized groups, consult the City’s field-reservation rules and field-status updates.

cards.title: Seasonal swim sessions on Golf Course Drive
cards.subtitle: Golf Course Drive corridor — Honeybee Pool
cards.notes: Check the City aquatics schedule before going; Honeybee offers scheduled lap swim, recreation swim, and swim-school periods in the summer season.
cards.short_summary: A City pool with distinct lap, recreation, and instruction sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s aquatics page schedules Honeybee Pool for lap swim, recreation swim, and swim school during its summer season.
cards.access_notes: Schedules are seasonal and date-specific; verify the City’s current schedule. Admission or program fees may apply.

cards.title: Tennis courts on Santa Dorotea Circle
cards.subtitle: Santa Dorotea Circle corridor — Dorotea Park
cards.notes: Bring racquets for the two lighted courts, or use the play and picnic areas; follow posted park rules and reserve group use through the City.
cards.short_summary: A City park with tennis, basketball, youth baseball, play, and picnic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s park-use policy lists Dorotea Park at 895 Santa Dorotea with two lighted tennis courts, a lighted basketball court, a youth baseball field, play areas, and picnic facilities.
cards.source_title: City of Rohnert Park Park/Facility Use and Reservation Policy
cards.access_notes: Group use is subject to the City’s park-use and reservation policy.

cards.title: Softball field on Snyder Lane
cards.subtitle: Snyder Lane corridor — Sunrise Park
cards.notes: Check field status and league schedules before arranging play; the City identifies the Sunrise Park softball field at 5201 Snyder Lane.
cards.short_summary: A named City field location used in the municipal Junior Giants schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Sunrise Park’s softball field at 5201 Snyder Lane among its Junior Giants field locations.
cards.access_notes: Confirm field conditions and whether the field is reserved before use.

cards.title: Youth baseball field on Southwest Boulevard
cards.subtitle: Southwest Boulevard corridor — Colegio Vista Park
cards.notes: Use this as a daylight stop for the playground or picnic tables, and check City scheduling if you intend to use the baseball or soccer field.
cards.short_summary: A City park with a youth field plus compact play and picnic amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City’s park-use policy lists Colegio Vista Park at 1200 Southwest Boulevard with a play structure, picnic tables, barbecue pit, and youth baseball and soccer field.
cards.source_title: City of Rohnert Park Park/Facility Use and Reservation Policy
cards.access_notes: Use of fields by organized groups may require a City permit or reservation.

cards.title: Summer recreation swim on Middlebrook Way
cards.subtitle: Middlebrook Way corridor — Magnolia Pool
cards.notes: Check the City’s current pool calendar before you go; Magnolia Pool is at Magnolia Park and operates on a summer schedule for lap and recreation swim.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal municipal pool located within Magnolia Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City states that Magnolia Pool is at Magnolia Park, 1501 Middlebrook Way, and publishes summer lap-swim and recreation-swim schedules.
cards.source_title: City of Rohnert Park Pool Facilities
cards.access_notes: The City identifies Magnolia as a summer-season pool; confirm dates, session times, and any admission fee before visiting.
